verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Moneybird capability for scheduling general recurring jobs or workflows. The only recurring element is subscription billing ("recurring billing for SaaS"), which is a domain-specific invoicing feature, not user-defined scheduled workflows. Webhooks, MCP and the CLI are event-driven or on-demand channels, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
